title: The Dangers of a Lame-Duck Trump
gist: Drezner and Saunders argue that a lame-duck Trump, cornered by a Democratic Congress and having exhausted spectacle diplomacy, is most likely to lash out militarily — first via renewed escalation in Iran (risking shipping attacks, Gulf strikes and a global economic crisis) and possibly regime change in Cuba — or to pursue family enrichment; doing nothing would be the best case.
